title: Handcrafted: The Behind the scenes of my 3D animation!
description:
I’m sharing a behind-the-scenes look at my animation process in Blender! I hope this gives you some inspiration for your own creations.
This project was made entirely in Blender. It took about 15 hours in total, and I managed to finish it all in a single day!
